vintage: GUS population 31 December 2025; demographic rates and life expectancy 2025; university students 31 December 2025; territorial division 1 January 2026; GUS, October 2026, May 2026, and December 2025

fields.label: Population
fields.description: Residents on 31 December 2025 (GUS).

fields.label: Density
fields.description: Residents per km² (GUS, 31 December 2025; area on 1 January 2026).

fields.label: Change 2015-2025
fields.description: Population on 31 December 2025 ÷ population on 31 December 2015 - 1 (GUS). Each year is on its own borders: a gmina whose borders changed (Opole in 2017, Kamienica and Supraśl in 2025) shows that change too.

fields.label: Net migration
fields.description: People who moved in minus people who moved out, within Poland and from abroad, per 1,000 residents (GUS, 2025). Powiat: the population-weighted mean of its gminas.

fields.label: Aged 65+
fields.description: Residents aged 65 or more ÷ all residents (GUS, 31 December 2025). Powiat: the population-weighted mean of its gminas.

fields.label: Births
fields.description: Live births per 1,000 residents (GUS, 2025). Powiat: the population-weighted mean of its gminas.

fields.label: Ukrainians (PESEL UKR)
fields.description: Ukrainian citizens with a PESEL UKR number (temporary protection) registered in the powiat, per 1,000 residents. The register shows where the number was issued, not where the person lives now.

fields.label: PIT revenue per person
fields.description: The gmina's share of personal income tax planned for 2026 ÷ residents (Ministry of Finance, GUS population of 31 December 2025). It follows residents' taxable incomes. Powiat: the population-weighted mean of its gminas.

fields.label: Average wage
fields.description: Average gross monthly wage, by employer seat (GUS wage distribution, May 2026).

fields.label: Unemployment
fields.description: Registered unemployment rate, end of October 2026 (GUS).

fields.label: Higher education
fields.description: Residents aged 13 or more with a higher-education diploma (NSP 2021 census, 31 March 2021).

fields.label: Doctors
fields.description: Doctors counted at their main place of work, per 10,000 residents (GUS, 2024). City powiats with big hospitals rank high, the rural powiats around them low.

fields.label: Roman Catholic
fields.description: Residents who declared the Roman Catholic Church, as a share of all residents (NSP 2021 census). About a fifth of residents (21% in Poland) did not answer the voluntary question. Powiat: the population-weighted mean of its gminas.

fields.label: No religion
fields.description: Residents who declared no religion, as a share of all residents (NSP 2021 census). Powiat: the population-weighted mean of its gminas.

fields.label: President 2025
fields.description: Second round, 1 June 2025: Karol Nawrocki's share of valid votes (PKW). The rest went to Rafał Trzaskowski. Powiat: the population-weighted mean of its gminas.

fields.label: Turnout 2025
fields.description: Valid ballot papers ÷ eligible voters, presidential election second round, 1 June 2025 (PKW). Powiat: the population-weighted mean of its gminas.

fields.label: Forest
fields.description: Share of the land with tree cover (ESA WorldCover 2021), averaged over the gmina's hex samples. Powiat: the population-weighted mean of its gminas.

fields.label: Farmland
fields.description: Share of the land in cropland or meadow and pasture below 900 m (ESA WorldCover 2021). Powiat: the population-weighted mean of its gminas.

fields.label: Built-up
fields.description: Share of the land that is built up (ESA WorldCover 2021). Powiat: the population-weighted mean of its gminas.

fields.label: Workers
fields.description: People working, by employer seat (GUS, 31 December 2025, PKD table).

fields.label: Food
fields.description: The Food yield of the powiat (see the Yields page).

fields.label: Production
fields.description: The Production yield of the powiat (see the Yields page).

fields.label: Gold
fields.description: The Gold yield of the powiat (see the Yields page).

fields.label: Science
fields.description: The Science yield of the powiat (see the Yields page).

fields.label: Culture
fields.description: The Culture yield of the powiat (see the Yields page).
